[EVENT] User is planning a road trip from Denver to Aspen, Colorado.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The drive from Denver to Aspen is approximately 160 miles and takes around 3-4 hours, depending on traffic and scenic stops.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The most direct route from Denver to Aspen is via I-70 W and CO-82 E.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested scenic stops along the way include Georgetown, Loveland Pass, Copper Mountain, Glenwood Springs, and Maroon Bells.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Georgetown is known for its historic architecture, quaint shops, and scenic train rides.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Loveland Pass offers stunning views of the Continental Divide and the Rocky Mountains.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Copper Mountain Resort offers scenic chairlift rides and stunning views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Glenwood Springs is famous for its natural hot springs pool and stunning scenery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Maroon Lake offers breathtaking views of the Maroon Bells, one of Colorado's most photographed mountains.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for the trip include checking road conditions, filling up on gas and snacks in Denver, and using a mapping app or GPS device.  
[USER] User is considering taking the scenic route and stopping at Loveland Pass and Copper Mountain.  
[USER] User inquired about the road conditions on CO-82 E during this time of year.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] CO-82 E is a well-maintained highway, but conditions can change rapidly depending on the weather.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Possible conditions during spring and early summer include snow and ice in higher elevations, wet and slippery roads, and potential rockfall or debris.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended checking the Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT) website for up-to-date road conditions and closures.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using winter tires or chains if driving during winter months, but conditions are generally better in spring and early summer.  
[USER] User is thinking of stopping at Maroon Lake but is unsure if there is enough time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Maroon Lake is approximately 10 miles southwest of Aspen, and the drive takes around 20-30 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Maroon Lake is highly recommended for its stunning scenery and is worth the detour if the user has at least 1-2 hours to spare.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested activities at Maroon Lake include hiking around the lake, having a picnic, and taking photos.
